differential_expression_rows.name: differential_expression_rows
differential_expression_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  gene_symbol,
  doid,
  pvalue
FROM
  differential_expression
differential_expression_rows.description: Row-level cohort of differential expression measurements (one row per gene_symbol x doid), exposing statistical measures and counts for reuse in filtering, aggregation, and joins.

disease_labeled.name: disease_labeled
disease_labeled.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.id AS id,
  d.name AS name
FROM
  disease d
disease_labeled.description: Normalized disease table exposing disease id and canonical name for lookups and joins to disease ontology IDs (DOIDs).

cancer_tissue_mapping.name: cancer_tissue_mapping
cancer_tissue_mapping.body_sql:
SELECT
  ct.doid AS doid,
  ct.uberon_anatomical_id AS uberon_anatomical_id
FROM
  cancer_tissue ct
WHERE
  ct.doid IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  ct.doid,
  ct.uberon_anatomical_id
cancer_tissue_mapping.description: Mapping of cancer disease ontology ids (doid) to anatomical Uberon IDs to support queries that connect diseases to tissues/organs.
